column1: #   overlay  + kga:<Action>            -- invoke kglobalaccel action twice
#   overlay  + kga2:<On>:<Off>         -- distinct on/off actions (zoom in/out)
#   overlay  + kgaN:A1|A2|A3|...       -- round-robin across N actions (one per
#                                         call), each invoked twice to toggle.
#   winaction+ kga:<Action>            -- spawn xterm, invoke action on it,
#   twinswap + -                       -- spawn two xterms, swap focus between
#   blurwin  + <atom_name>             -- spawn xterm, stamp the named X11 atom
#                                         on it, wait for kwin to react
#                                         the property is set on a real client)
#   login, logout, sessionquit   -- session lifecycle, would log user out
#   kscreen, frozenapp, fullscreen, eyeonscreen, dimscreen, screenedge,
#   overview (the legacy V1)     -- "Effect is not supported" on this fork
# Overlay effects -- fullscreen UI activated via global shortcut
# Window add/close animations -- fired by spawning + killing xterm
# Listed but won't fully animate from xterm spawn alone:
#   wobblywindows   needs user-driven move/resize (we can't safely enter
#   dialogparent    needs WM_TRANSIENT_FOR set (real dialog parent)
#   highlightwindow needs explicit org.kde.KWin DBus highlight call
# Their plugin lifecycle is still tested by the surrounding load/unload.
# Focus-driven (need two windows on screen, focus swapping between them)
# Window-action animations -- spawn xterm, invoke action on it, then close
# (covers maximize/minimize/shade animations that fire on a specific signal)
# Property-driven filters -- only allocate when a window carries the right atom
# Other filters -- exercised via plugin load/unload (no per-window trigger)
